company_name: 广东顺威精密塑料股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-cutoff underwriting of operating durability, cash conversion, financing resilience and permanent-loss paths; no post-cutoff outcomes or price claims.
underwriting_route: Assess the mature air-conditioner fan-blade chain as the base enterprise, while isolating new projects and cash accessibility as conditional or scenario claims.

situation_model.summary: The company serves major domestic and international appliance customers through direct, make-to-order sales and an integrated modified-plastic, tooling and fan-blade chain. Revenue grew through FY2017, but earnings and operating cash weakened as costs, inventory, projects and financing needs rose.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Mature appliance-component competition with customer scale bargaining power; design and tooling integration can defend share, but input costs and working-capital demands remain cyclical.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit accrues to suppliers that reliably meet customer specifications, tooling and delivery requirements; large OEM customers retain bargaining leverage and can pressure component pricing.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: The company is concentrated in appliance fan blades and related plastics/tooling, with top-five customers representing about half of sales in FY2015-FY2017.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: Direct contracting, make-to-order production and integrated design-tooling-formula capabilities support retention; Thailand, smart-bathroom and other projects broaden exposure but lack disclosed standalone economics.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Core economics are observable only in aggregate. FY2016 profit and cash improved, while FY2017 reported an adjusted loss amid cost increases, inventory impairment and project/transaction expenses, so normalization is conditional.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Persistent margin pressure, inventory and receivables growth, elevated borrowing and unproven expansion could destroy owner value even without immediate insolvency.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a price-free primary route tied to normalized mature-core earning power; keep project growth and liquidation outcomes conditional or excluded until returns and realization are evidenced.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: Large air-conditioner OEMs' in-house fan-blade production or alternative qualified suppliers that use customer scale to compress component margins.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff annual reports show sustained core margin and adjusted-profit recovery while inventory and receivables normalize.
Project disclosures provide matched capital, mature earnings, cash conversion and ordinary-shareholder realization for Thailand or smart-bathroom investments.
Debt, working-capital and long-lived-asset spending fall to levels supportable by recurring operating cash without refinancing dependence.

business_position: Integrated modified-plastic, tooling and fan-blade capabilities plus direct relationships with major OEMs are a defensible service proposition, but customer concentration and scale bargaining power limit pricing authority.
survival_case: FY2017 cash of approximately RMB230.6m and no reported asset restrictions provide liquidity, yet short-term borrowings rose to about RMB350.5m, a RMB50m loan became current, and operating cash was only RMB7.2m; survival therefore depends on working-capital release, financing access and disciplined spending.
adaptation_case: Make-to-order direct sales and specification-led design can preserve the core; overseas and smart-bathroom initiatives are treated as conditional because standalone revenue, profit and cash are not disclosed.
normalization_case: A mature-core range is anchored to disclosed FY2016 adjusted profit and FY2015-FY2017 volatility. FY2017 cost inflation, inventory impairment and one-off project/transaction items may normalize, but no point estimate is authorized and new-project returns remain unknown.
permanent_loss_map: Permanent loss can arise through customer-driven margin erosion, receivable/inventory cash absorption, refinancing burden, and retention of capital in projects without demonstrated incremental owner cash. The unknown project economics are localized rather than propagated to the independently evidenced core.

value_route.route_reasoning: The mature-core normalized-earnings route is the only currently supportable operating route; project growth lacks return evidence and liquidation lacks a disclosed execution path.

strongest_rival: Large air-conditioner OEMs' in-house fan-blade production or alternative qualified suppliers that use customer scale to compress component margins.
reversal_observations: Post-cutoff annual reports show sustained core margin and adjusted-profit recovery while inventory and receivables normalize.
Project disclosures provide matched capital, mature earnings, cash conversion and ordinary-shareholder realization for Thailand or smart-bathroom investments.
Debt, working-capital and long-lived-asset spending fall to levels supportable by recurring operating cash without refinancing dependence.

component_treatments.reason: Integrated plastics, tooling and fan-blade operations with multi-year OEM customer relationships are disclosed across FY2015-FY2017.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the base operating judgment, subject to customer bargaining and cyclical input-cost risk.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote confidence if post-cutoff adjusted margins and cash conversion recover while concentration remains manageable.

component_treatments.reason: Thailand, smart-bathroom and other expansion activities are disclosed, but standalone revenue, profit, capital and cash returns are unavailable.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: No base growth value; include only as a conditional opportunity and financing use.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Require project-level capital, mature earnings, working-capital absorption and ordinary-shareholder cash evidence.

component_treatments.reason: Other precision components and minority investment are identified without comparable economics or realization terms.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Excluded from base earnings and owner cash; monitor for downside or optionality only.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only with audited segment economics and a credible realization or distribution path.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Sustained adjusted profitability and operating cash after normalizing inventory and input costs.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Persistent core losses or cash absorption despite normalized demand and customer retention.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Disclose project-level invested capital, mature returns and cash remittance.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Further spending, impairments or refinancing without matched project cash generation.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Obtain segment-level earnings, ownership and realization evidence.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Evidence of continuing losses, encumbrance or no feasible realization path.

evidence_trace.scope: Products, integrated chain, direct sales and named OEM customers.
evidence_trace.used_for: Core business position and customer exposure.

evidence_trace.scope: Revenue, reported and adjusted profit, operating cash.
Cost increases, inventory impairment, project and financing expenses.
Minority investment, fund-raising projects and unused proceeds.
Thailand base, smart-bathroom preparation and related costs.
Cash, receivables, inventory, payables, borrowings and long-lived-asset spending.
Revenue and operating cash series used as driver sensitivity inputs.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: Integrated fan-blade operations can remain viable, but customer bargaining, cost inflation, working-capital absorption and unproven projects constrain normalized owner economics.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Underwrite a bounded mature-core range; treat project contributions as conditional and do not convert FY2017 loss or missing returns into a point estimate.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Use operating cash less economic maintenance needs conceptually; total long-lived-asset spending and working-capital expansion increase financing pressure, while exact maintenance split and cash accessibility remain unresolved.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Base path includes slow margin erosion and cash absorption; conditional path covers low-return project retention and refinancing dependence.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Keep the mature-core normalized-earnings route primary, projects conditional and liquidation excluded pending a realization mechanism.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: Large air-conditioner OEMs' in-house fan-blade production or alternative qualified suppliers that use customer scale to compress component margins.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Track adjusted core margins, inventory/receivable days, operating cash after spending, borrowings and project-level return and remittance disclosures at the specified feedback clocks.

investment_treatment: Research-only pre-outcome treatment: conditionally underwrite the mature core, exclude unproven growth from base economics, and require reversal evidence before promotion; no price, return or action is authorized.

basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated mature fan-blade, modified-plastic and tooling operations

rows.economic_reason: FY2016 adjusted profit was positive while FY2015 and FY2017 were near zero or negative; a bounded reference captures observed volatility without a point estimate.

quantification.reason: Standalone project earnings and capital returns are not disclosed.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Exclude from base and retain as conditional only.

rows.economic_reason: Projects may add earnings but their contribution cannot be isolated.

quantification.reason: Noncore component economics and realization are not disclosed.

rows.economic_reason: Other components and minority interests lack comparable standalone data.

normal_earnings.basis: Aggregate revenue variation is not reconciled to component margin or customer pricing.

delta.reason: No disclosed margin bridge by revenue case.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not attribute a numeric earnings delta.

owner_cash.basis: Revenue changes also alter inventory and receivables, whose cash timing is not fixed.

delta.reason: No disclosed cash conversion by revenue case.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not attribute a numeric owner-cash delta.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated core operations; excludes project-level returns and noncore asset realization.
